title: docsrs-cli schema success data
description: Payload under envelope.data for command schema. Outer envelope always has schema_version=1, ok, command, duration_ms. Two shapes come out of this one command: --cmd <name> embeds a single document, --cmd all embeds the whole bundle. Both are described here because a validator handed only the single shape rejects the bundle this repository's own index recommends.

oneOf.title: schema --cmd <name>
oneOf.description: One embedded JSON Schema document for the requested command success data.

schema.description: Embedded JSON Schema document for the requested command success data. additionalProperties is true because the document is itself a free-form JSON Schema.

oneOf.title: schema --cmd all
oneOf.description: The whole bundle in one call: every wire name paired with its embedded document.

mode.description: Present only in bundle mode and absent from the single-document shape, so it is the field that tells the two apart

commands.description: Every wire name the bundle carries, in dispatch order: the nine top-level commands, the six nested cache/config names, and the five names that describe a shape rather than an invocation (error, dry-run, agent-surface, cache, config)

items.description: One entry per name in commands, same order and same length

schema.description: Embedded JSON Schema document. additionalProperties is true because the document is itself a free-form JSON Schema.
